key_contribution: An internationally recognized peer-reviewed journal dedicated to multidisciplinary research on ethical issues in academic institutions and governance. The journal publishes original research, review articles, and opinion pieces on academic integrity, research conduct, faculty relationships, institutional management, and ethical governance in post-secondary education. Over two decades of publication, it has become a leading venue for scholars examining how ethical principles apply in contemporary academic settings, including emerging challenges from artificial intelligence and generative technologies.

scope_and_aims.article_types: Original research articles, review articles, opinion pieces, book reviews, and commentaries

relevance_to_ai_integrity: The Journal of Academic Ethics is the primary peer-reviewed publication venue for scholarly research on AI and academic integrity in higher education. The journal publishes rigorous empirical studies, policy analyses, and ethical frameworks examining how generative AI systems impact student behavior, faculty responsibilities, institutional governance, and research conduct. Recent publications (2024-2025) specifically address academic integrity in the era of GenAI, student perceptions of AI tool ethics, and governance reforms needed to maintain institutional integrity standards.
